question:
An unknown porous material is brought to your laboratory. The material contains already some water, but clearly not all pores are filled.

The following measurements are taken:
1. Total mass of the sample as it was brought into the lab: ${m_tot}\text{{ g}}$
2. Mass of the oven-dried sample: ${m_dry}\text{{ g}}$
3. Total volume of the sample: ${V_tot}\text{{ cm}}^3$
4. Density of the matrix materials: ${rho_matrix}\text{{ g/cm}}^3$

Calculate the porosity $\phi$ to two decimal places
For the same sample, calculate the void ratio $e$ to two decimal places
Bonus question: For the same sample, calculate the volumetric water content $\theta$ to two decimal places
What would be the mass of $1\text{{ m}}^3$ of the unknown porous material if it was completely saturated? Answer in kg and one decimal place.
